paper_metadata.title: A molecular dynamic investigation of cyclic strengthening mechanism of Ni-based single crystal superalloy

evidence.quote: Ni-based single crystal superalloys, as crucial materials in the aviation and aerospace industry, frequently encounter fatigue failure induced by cyclic loading, which is one of the primary failure modes.
Considering the limitations of the potential function and the primary characteristics of Ni-based single crystal superalloys, the alloy has been simplified to the Ni/Ni3Al system.
In this study, two typical feature models of Ni-based single crystal superalloy are constructed using MD method to investigate the evolution of dislocations under cyclic loading.
